entities.name: Mutant
entities.description: A creature type for beings altered by unnatural factors, magical or biological.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact whose power soaks into Otaria, mutating its inhabitants.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian turned druid who planted the Mirari in the Otarian forest of Krosa.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: Otarian forest where Kamahl lived and planted the Mirari; its beasts mutate.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Continent whose inhabitants, especially aven, are mutated by the Mirari.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan that warps and mutates biological life into her spawn.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose will twisted the first phyrexians, mutated Thran humans, through oil baths.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Ravnican guild of biomancers who create mutants; its members often mutate themselves.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Simic leader whose declining influence preceded the resurgence of the Combine.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: Prime Speaker under whom the Simic mutate intelligent members into super soldiers.

entities.name: Incurables
entities.description: Ogres on Grixis mutated by stale magical energy.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara where stale magic mutated some denizens.

entities.name: Krasis
entities.description: A mix of two species created by Simic experiments, now feral.

entities.name: Crookclaws
entities.description: Mutant owl aven that grew larger and sprouted wing talons while keeping use of their arms.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane whose Simic biomancers create mutants.

events.summary: Kamahl plants the Mirari in Krosa; its power soaks into the continent and mutates the inhabitants, driving forest beasts mad.
events.quote: it was he who planted the Mirari there thinking that without a wielder the artifact would be harmless.

events.summary: The Mirari's magic washes across Otaria, making many aven taller and more muscular with razor-like talons.
events.quote: many aven became taller and more muscular

events.summary: Simic biomancers create the mutants of Ravnica in attempts to improve life forms.
events.quote: were responsible for the mutants of Ravnica in their attempts to improve the life forms of that plane.

events.summary: Under Prime Speaker Vannifar the Simic mutate their more intelligent members into super soldiers.
events.quote: the Simic started to mutate their more intelligent members into super soldiers

relations.quote: it was he who planted the Mirari there

relations.note: Her influence mutates life into her spawn.
relations.quote: The Eldrazi Titan Emrakul warps and corrupts biological life, mutating it into her spawn .
